## Checklist

- [ ] The change contains no personal or patient information.
- [ ] I have the right to share this content, and it is not copied from a source whose license forbids it.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes on my machine.
- [ ] If I changed a JSON file, I updated the matching JSONL records (per-language file and combined file).
- [ ] I did not rename, add, remove or move fields, or this pull request is about the format and links an agreed issue.
- [ ] I updated the README if file names, counts, formats or known issues changed.
- [ ] I added a line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`.

### For health content

- [ ] The content follows current national or WHO guidance, named above.
- [ ] A clinical reviewer has been requested.

### For local-language content

- [ ] The text was written or checked by a first-language speaker. It is not unreviewed machine translation.
- [ ] A language reviewer has been requested.
